And no finite k-test could ever COMPLETE the o(log t) test.  HONEST WALL: numerical search is a counterexample engine - it can find a disproof (an off-line zero, or S growing like c log t) but it cannot prove RH, because RH is the global statement S(t) = o(log t) and every finite quiet census is compatible with a violation just beyond the frontier.
